content.title: Los Angeles Lakers vs Detroit Pistons Live Stream: How to Watch NBA
content.text: The Los Angeles Lakers go for their 10th straight win against the Detroit Pistons on Monday, who are without Cade Cunningham. The Los Angeles Lakers go up against the best team in the Eastern Conference for a 10-game winning streak against the Detroit Pistons on Monday night. This will be a rematch of the 2004 NBA Finals and would likely be the most impressive win of this winning streak if the Lakers pull off the road win. Los Angeles has shot up the Western Conference standings after winning 12 of its last 13 games. This is already the Lakers’ longest winning streak of the season as they try to tie this season series in this finale on Monday. Detroit won by a comfortable margin in LA in the series opener on Dec. 30, 128-106. It was not the birthday present that LeBron James was looking for as Cade Cunningham led the Pistons with 27 points and 11 assists. Luka Doncic came to play, though, with a game-high 30 points and 11 assists. It was the fourth loss in five games for the Lakers, who have now turned a new leaf. Los Angeles is only five games back of Detroit in the win column, and the Pistons will have a tough time even at home tonight since Cunningham isn’t expected back until April 8 with a chest injury. The Lakers subsequently will be the slight 2.5-point favorite on the road Monday. Detroit is going for its fourth win in a row, and the Pistons have won six of their last seven after beating the Golden State Warriors at home on Friday, 115-101. The Pistons were able to survive without Cunningham, especially since Golden State is still without Steph Curry, who is dealing with a knee injury. Jalen Duren led the club with 23 points, and Daniss Jenkins played well in place of Cunningham with 22 points. Golden State’s cause didn’t fare better when Kristaps Porzingis left the game with a back injury. Los Angeles narrowly kept its winning streak alive with a 105-104 comeback win over the Orlando Magic on Saturday. Luke Kennard hit a clutch three-pointer with just 0.6 seconds left. James made his 1,612th regular-season game appearance, which is an NBA record. James scored 12 points with six rebounds, while Doncic led the team with 33 points. But Doncic earned his 16th technical foul, which warranted a one-game suspension. The league rescinded the technical foul, so he will be available against the Pistons.
